text: Prompt! ... Ready! Commit! Push! ... Auto-merge! Close your laptops! Buy more GPUs. Now listen to me. Every company is going to run its own software factory. Tokens go in, software comes out, and the factory never sleeps. So you build it, you feed it, and you are going to love it.
voice_description: A Taiwanese-American man in his early sixties, a charismatic tech founder on a giant keynote stage. Warm, slightly raspy mid-range voice with a light accent. Playful and excitable, punchy delivery with sudden emphasis and big pauses, a hint of a chuckle. Clean close-mic studio recording, no reverb.
